name: Xayah
notes: Clean Cuts' pass-through (secondary target) damage from an empowered attack never triggers in this fight because there is no second enemy for a feather to pass through onto; only the primary hit (identical to a normal attack) lands, so Clean Cuts contributes no extra damage on its own and only matters for planting feathers that feed Bladecaller.

Every basic attack consumes a Clean Cuts stack when one is available (and not expired) and plants a feather on the ground; Clean Cuts' 5-stack pool is treated as one shared timer that resets to 8 seconds on every ability cast (Q, W, E or R), matching 'lasting for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts'.

Double Daggers' two missiles are both read as landing on the single dummy (first hit full damage, second hit the stated 50%-reduced damage), the common in-game reading for a lone, centered target; each missile also plants a feather on the ground at its stated delay (0.334s / 0.584s after cast) rather than at the moment of cast.
Double Daggers' cast time (and the matching attack lockout) shrinks with total bonus attack speed at 0.07s per 100%, floored at 0.1s, per the wiki's stated formula.

Bladecaller is cast as soon as it is off cooldown and at least one feather is currently planted (feathers persist 6 seconds, XayahPassive.PFeatherDuration); its damage uses the disclosed diminishing-returns formula over however many feathers are live at that moment, all of which are then cleared. The feather queue tracked here is capped at 8 concurrent feathers, comfortably above what attack speed and Q casts can plant within one 6-second window, so the formula's n<=19 branch always applies.

Bladecaller's per-feather damage is scaled once by (1 + 0.5 * critChance * (critDamage - 1)) using the champion's current crit stats, matching the ability's stated crit-chance/crit-damage scaling; this scaling is baked in manually rather than through the engine's standard crit multiplier since it uses a reduced (0.5) coefficient.

Deadly Plumage is cast for its attack-speed frenzy as soon as it is off cooldown; the extra on-hit feather it grants deals 25% of the triggering attack's damage and is modeled with the same expected crit scaling as the triggering attack, per the wiki.

Featherstorm is cast once at t=0, since its 100-140s cooldown far exceeds the fight length and casting immediately minimizes lost attack/cast time later; Xayah cannot attack or cast Q/W/E during its leap. The wiki text states the untargetable window is 1.5 seconds while the game's data value reads 1.25 seconds; the wiki's 1.5s is used here and the discrepancy is flagged.
Bladecaller's root and Deadly Plumage's movement speed bonus are ignored: crowd control and mobility do not matter in this fight.
Mana costs are not modeled: Xayah's level-16 mana pool and regen comfortably cover casting Q/W/E on cooldown plus one R over an 8-15s fight.
